document_level_policies.description: Load component structure, metadata, exact geometry and editable feature data wherever available.
Load structure, transforms, bounds and display tessellation; defer exact B-rep and part history.
Load the assembly occurrence tree and essential metadata without component geometry.
Fully load selected components while keeping the remainder lightweight, structure-only or unloaded.
Start light and promote component data automatically when an operation requires it.

selection_overrides.recursive_depth: 0 = selected occurrence only; positive values include descendants; -1 means entire selected subtree.
selection_overrides.reference_set: Optional preferred reference set/representation for a component.
selection_overrides.load_interpart_dependencies: Whether associative external references may promote referenced components.
selection_overrides.load_pmi: none, visible, or all PMI payloads.
selection_overrides.load_attributes: none, essential, or all user/component attributes.
selection_overrides.memory_budget_mib: Optional soft memory budget used by partial/load-on-demand policies.
selection_overrides.io_concurrency: Optional bounded component I/O concurrency; independent from geometry worker count.

promotion_rules: Selection/highlight needs only occurrence identity plus a display proxy.
Measurement may promote to exact geometry only for the measured occurrence(s).
Editing a component requires editable part history for that component, not the whole assembly.
Assembly constraints may load only the referenced datums/topology needed by the solver.
AI inspection must request the lightest representation that can answer the question.
